conclusions.protocol: queued 0/3, sequential 3/3; all queued third requests stall, 125-byte server receive queue matches third request length. Official Halo 2.26.1 known defect remains reproducible.
conclusions.browser: 8 networkidle cases passed. DCL-only collector is insufficient: initial batch 11/12, corrected DCL batch 1/4; collector closure races are retained, not counted as historical 30-second resource stalls or product fixes. Original unmodified browser/run.mjs Firefox40 subsequently passed 40/40 with normal full readiness sequence, 750 responses; report remains incomplete because Chromium/WebKit are omitted. Historical failures remain unresolved.
conclusions.attribution: No causal mapping from these protocol failures to every historical browser failure. No product patch or timeout increase.
conclusions.next: Replay formal Halo build after official upstream fix; current full browser acceptance must keep normal readiness sequence.
